name: MAXLAND
recent: MAXLAND 于 2026 年 10 月至 11 月完成一项可放弃供股计划，以每股 RM0.025 发行最多 2,405,444,311 股供股股份，认购不足 52.89%，但最低认购水平已达成，供股股份于 2026 年 11 月 23 日上市。公司于 2026 年 10 月 30 日公布截至 2026 年 8 月 31 日止季度的合并业绩。此外，公司于 2026 年 9 月 8 日举行股东大会，并有多项董事及委员会成员变动。
notable: 完成可放弃供股，发行最多 2,405,444,311 股供股股份，每股 RM0.025，认购率 47.11%，供股股份于 2026 年 11 月 23 日上市。
供股计划出现 52.89% 的认购不足，但最低认购水平已达成。
2026 年 9 月 8 日举行股东大会，并有多项董事及委员会成员变动。
risks: 供股计划认购不足 52.89%，可能影响集资规模。
供股发行大量新股，可能对现有股东权益产生摊薄影响。
董事在闭窗期前表示有意进行交易，需留意后续股权变动。

recent_en: MAXLAND completed a renounceable rights issue between October and November 2026, issuing up to 2,405,444,311 rights shares at RM0.025 each, with a 52.89% under-subscription but the minimum subscription level achieved; the rights shares were listed on 23 November 2026. The company announced its consolidated quarterly results for the financial period ended 31 August 2026 on 30 October 2026. Additionally, general meetings were held on 8 September 2026, along with several changes in directors and board committees.
notable_en: Completed a renounceable rights issue of up to 2,405,444,311 rights shares at RM0.025 each, with a subscription rate of 47.11%; the rights shares were listed on 23 November 2026.
The rights issue was under-subscribed by 52.89%, but the minimum subscription level was achieved.
General meetings were held on 8 September 2026, along with several changes in directors and board committees.
risks_en: The rights issue was under-subscribed by 52.89%, which may affect the fundraising size.
The issuance of a large number of new shares under the rights issue may dilute existing shareholders' equity.
Directors indicated intention to deal during the closed period; subsequent shareholding changes should be monitored.
